Use case: loading-screen background
Asset type: full-bleed loading screen and menu background for the "Puzzles" collection of an original educational mobile-first game. Request 1080x1920 pixels or the highest native resolution available in this aspect ratio.
Place: A fern garden with stone circles under a twisted white spire.
World: The planet Raya: untouched nature fills at least 70% of the frame. Tall, slender, white acoustic and telecom towers (300 to 1200 m) rise in the distance; they are thin and few. Small white lattice nests hide in the trees. Rayans in tight white futuristic clothing appear small, walking, playing or gliding acoustically along invisible sky-lanes near a tower, some with floating white Orbi spheres. No roads, cars, fences, power lines or crowds.
Composition: a wide, calm landscape with a quiet, low-detail band in the lower third where the game will draw its progress indicator; no interface drawn.
Art direction: luminous painterly realism with a soft anime influence, deep atmospheric perspective and natural light.
Constraints: one complete standalone image, no text, letters, logos, watermarks or user interface. Original composition. No violence or weapons.
